notesEn: 0.3.61: Fix context overflow after B-machine sync. Root cause: sync restores projcache carrying A-machine token measurement cache (surfaceTokens > contextWindow), causing B-machine compaction to fail (missing model config / no contextWindow) -> throws TargetPressureConfigError, only warns, no compaction -> full surface sent to provider -> CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED. Fix: apply.ps1 skips session_projcache sync, letting DSH rebuild from session log on boot (using B-machine actual model config). projcache is a rebuildable coldSnapshot; dsh-session-manager Step 2 re-folds on boot.
